limitations: Independent review round 1 returned FAIL (sex/strain); fixed, re-review pending.
Nephron 2016 full text not openly available; only the abstract and PubMed MeSH headings were used.
Sex (male) and strain (Wistar) come from study-level PubMed MeSH headings, applied to all rows; sub-strain not asserted (sister paper PMC4240179 says Wistar Hannover, shared cohort unconfirmed).
Developmental stage not available: no age in the available record.
Instrument chosen as Orbitrap Elite over the raw header's configured name and the sister paper's 'Velos Pro'.
N-term C modification (-17.026549 Da, mislabelled UNIMOD:28 in the mzid) interpreted as UNIMOD:385 Ammonia-loss.
Organism part kept at kidney; cortex vs medulla not stated. FFPE preservation not captured in any column.
Biological replicate numbering within group is an annotator convention.
sdrf-tools reconcile reports a false-positive disease_on_control_runs blocker (reads only row 1's disease value); SHAM rows are 'normal'.
